questions.q: A price was $40 in the base year and $46 now. Find the index number.
Chain base index numbers are 106 for 2022 and 103 for 2023. What does 103 show?
options: the price rose 3% since the base year
questions.why: A chain base index compares each year with the previous year; 103 > 100 is still a rise.

questions.q: Item A has index 110 and weight 3; item B has index 130 and weight 1. Find the weighted index.
Why is a standardised death rate better than a crude death rate for comparing two towns?
questions.model: It applies each town's age-group rates to the same standard population, so it allows for the towns' different age structures.
